simple.summary: דָּהַם (dâham) means to be dumb , i.e. (figuratively) dumbfounded First listed occurrence: Jer 14 9.

definitions.full: H1724. daham [ דָּהַם ] verb astonish, astound (Arabic , ) — Niph`al Participle נִדְהָם כְּאִישׁ Jer 14:9 like a man astounded (|| להושׁיע יוכל לֹא כְּגִבּוֺר ); ᵐ5 ὑπνῶν נִרְדָּם .
